before=check(E12Compare.committed,s=@comparison/native-T3-after)
within=evaluate(E12Compare.singleton,s=@comparison/native-T3-after)
problem=prepare(E12Compare.committed,using=E12Compare.tune,on=@comparison/native-T3,s=@comparison/native-T3-after)
solveIt=solve($problem.problem,within=$within.value)
chosen=candidate($solveIt.solutions,index=0)
fixed=apply($chosen.assignment,in=$solveIt.solutions)
after=check(E12Compare.committed,s=@comparison/native-T3-after,on=$fixed.object)
native=assemble(E12Compare.only,on=@comparison/native-output1,along=E12Compare.noOverlap,t=@comparison/native-T3,local.t=$fixed.object)
rust=assemble(E12Compare.only,on=@comparison/rust-output1,along=E12Compare.noOverlap,t=@comparison/rust-T3)
migrate=assemble_map(E12Compare.consume,from=$native.assembly,to=$rust.assembly,t=@comparison/move-T3)
target=check(E12Compare.committed,s=@comparison/rust-T3-after,on=$migrate.map.target)
nativeWide=assemble(E12Compare.wide,on=@comparison/native-output1,along=E12Compare.noWideOverlap,t=@comparison/native-T3,c=@comparison/native-cancel,local.t=$fixed.object)
rustWide=assemble(E12Compare.wide,on=@comparison/rust-output1,along=E12Compare.noWideOverlap,t=@comparison/rust-T3,c=@comparison/rust-cancel)
nativeState=check(E12Compare.committed,s=@comparison/native-T3-after,on=$nativeWide.object)
rustState=check(E12Compare.committed,s=@comparison/rust-T3-after,on=$rustWide.object)
extended=assemble_map(E12Compare.routes,from=$nativeWide.assembly,to=$rustWide.assembly,t=@comparison/move-T3,c=@comparison/move-cancel)
nativeCancel=evaluate(E12Compare.observed,s=@comparison/native-cancel-retained,on=$nativeWide.object)
rustCancel=evaluate(E12Compare.observed,s=@comparison/rust-cancel-stopped,on=$rustWide.object)
